toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.argsSummary: bash command=which mmdc npx node 2>&1; ls ~/.npm 2>/dev/null | head; npm ls -g --depth=0 2>&1 | head -30

toolCalls.name: bash
toolCalls.argsSummary: bash command=cd <TEMP_PATH> && timeout 300 npx -y @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli@11 -i flow.mmd -o artifacts/flow.svg 2>&1 | tail -20

toolCalls.argsSummary: bash command=cd <TEMP_PATH> && export npm_config_cache=<TEMP_PATH> && timeout 600 npx -y @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli@11 -i flow.
